com.atakmap.android.gui.PanEditTextPrefe.android:title: Subscribe Topics
com.atakmap.android.gui.PanEditTextPrefe.android:summary: Zenoh key expressions to subscribe to, one per line. CoT received here is rendered on the map. Defaults to known CoT-bearing prefixes rather than everything (**) -- use ** for a one-off full mesh audit, since large non-CoT traffic (video, imagery, pcap replay) costs bandwidth/battery to receive and discard even when it's filtered out locally.
